use_cases.name: Enable an additional Indian language for a tenant
use_cases.goal: Make the screens, notifications, letters and Nucleus Talk voice available in the language spoken at each site, with every translation reviewed before workers see it.

stakeholders.interest: Reads payslips, leave balances and safety notices in the language they understand best.
Fewer helpdesk visits caused by misunderstood screens or letters at Peenya Works and the Bengaluru Corporate Office.
Statutory notices displayed in the local language where the site's rules require it (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: A tenant admin requests a new interface language for one or more sites, for example Kannada for the two Karnataka sites of Vindhya Precision Industries.
preconditions: The language pack (interface strings, number and date formats, voice model, letter phrasing) is published by the platform for the requested language.
The tenant admin holds the platform configuration scope for the tenant.
At least one language reviewer is assigned for the language.
postconditions_success: The language is enabled for the selected sites and appears in each eligible user's language selector.
Notifications, letters and Nucleus Talk respond in the user's chosen language, with English as the fallback for any untranslated string.
The enablement, the reviewer sign-off and the pack version are recorded in the audit trail.
postconditions_failure: The language stays disabled and no user sees partially translated screens.
The admin receives the list of strings or templates that failed review.

main_flow.action: Opens language settings, selects Kannada and chooses the sites LOC-PLA and LOC-BLR where it should be offered.
Checks the language pack coverage: interface strings, notification and letter templates, number and date formats, and voice support.
Lists tenant-specific texts (custom picklist values, letter clauses, announcements) that have no Kannada version yet.
Requests machine-assisted draft translations for the missing tenant texts and assigns them to the language reviewer.
Reviews each draft in context on the preview screens, corrects wording and approves the set.
Submits the enablement for approval through the approval engine.
Approves the enablement after checking the preview of payslip, leave and safety-notice screens.
Enables the language for the selected sites, records the pack version and reviewer sign-off, and notifies site users that Kannada is available.

alternate_flows.condition: Voice support for the language is not yet available in the published pack.
steps: The platform enables text interfaces only and marks Nucleus Talk for the language as unavailable.
Users choosing the language are told that voice continues in their second preferred language.

alternate_flows.condition: The reviewer rejects a draft translation of a statutory or payroll term.
steps: The reviewer records the approved glossary term.
The platform reapplies the glossary to every affected string and returns them for review.

exception_flows.condition: Interface string coverage for the language is below 100%.
exception_flows.handling: Enablement is blocked; the admin sees the coverage percentage and the missing string keys.
The language stays disabled and the rejection reason is sent to the tenant admin.

nfrs: Switching the interface language takes effect on the next screen load within 1 second at p95.
No released screen in an enabled language shows an untranslated key; English fallback is logged as a defect.
use_cases.frequency: Occasional — per tenant onboarding or site addition

user_stories.want: to see my payslip, leave balance and safety notices in Kannada
user_stories.so_that: I understand my pay and entitlements without asking a supervisor to explain them

acceptance.given: Kannada is enabled for site LOC-PLA and my language preference is Kannada
acceptance.then: every label, earning and deduction name is shown in Kannada and amounts use Indian digit grouping

acceptance.given: a tenant-specific announcement has no approved Kannada version
acceptance.then: I see the English text with a 'translation pending' marker and the gap is logged for the reviewer

user_stories.want: to enable a new language only after every string and tenant text has been reviewed
user_stories.so_that: workers never see half-translated or wrong statutory terms

acceptance.given: interface string coverage for Odia is 97%
acceptance.when: I try to enable Odia for a site
acceptance.then: enablement is blocked and the 3% missing string keys are listed

acceptance.given: all strings are covered and the reviewer has approved the tenant texts
acceptance.when: the HR administrator approves the enablement
acceptance.then: the language becomes selectable for the chosen sites and the audit trail records pack version, reviewer and approver
